hero.prompt: A Nordic twilight fjord horizon at the exact moment the cool silver-blue water-light of late Cancer meets the first warm gold of Leo precisely along the horizon line, a sun resting on the Cancer-Leo cusp. A cold-to-warm gradient sweeps across the sky, deep indigo to near-black at the top (#16112c fading to #0b0a1b) cooling the upper air, soft gold accents (#d4af6a) blooming at the waterline, an aurora-like teal-and-gold nebula wash drifting low over still fjord water. Painterly editorial illustration, atmospheric and symbolic, full-bleed wide 16:9 that fills the frame. ONE single continuous landscape scene, no split screen, no diptych, no two panels, no diagram, no chart wheel, no central framed card, no text or letters or numerals, no human faces
hero.altEn: A Nordic fjord horizon where cool late-Cancer silver-blue water-light meets the first warm gold of Leo at the waterline, a sun on the cusp
hero.altZh: 北欧峡湾的地平线上，巨蟹末度的银蓝水光在水际线与狮子座最初的暖金相遇，一颗落在交界上的太阳
